evidence: Lines 15813-17297: opm CLI coverage including about section describing catalog creation from bundles (lines 16232-16238), installation procedure (lines 16254-16325), and comprehensive CLI reference covering generate, index, init, migrate, render, serve, and validate commands (lines 16334-17297)
notes: The opm CLI has two distinct operational modes: the newer file-based catalog (declarative config) format and the deprecated SQLite database format.
